reviewed_limitations: Historical reported borrowing balances are not current market values or complete valuation debt. Review operating/finance leases and other financing claims separately.
Do not add a total term balance to its current/noncurrent components. Commercial paper held as an investment is an asset, not issued debt.
GOOG and GOOGL share issuer borrowing evidence. Do not add duplicate issuer balances across the two security records.

microsoft_scope_basis.decision: Use the exact balance-sheet amount; the debt note identifies its commercial-paper scope. The rounded note is not a different precise balance.

m06_treatment: Alphabet term carrying debt is USD12,870m / 11,882m / 48,543m for FY2023/2024/2025, distinct from face amounts USD13,000m / 12,000m / 49,085m. Current term portions are already included.
NVIDIA term carrying balances are USD9,709m / 8,463m / 8,468m for FY2024/2025/2026. They do not establish all lease and financing obligations.
Microsoft FY2024 issued commercial paper is USD6,693m and FY2025 is explicitly zero. Do not replace the exact balance with the rounded USD6.7bn narrative or use investment portfolio commercial paper.
Accept these historical facts and definitions only. All forecasts, financing weights, current shares, employee options, equity bridges and saved valuations retain their existing review state.
